name: Orisaku Akira
source:
She has a friendly personality that allows her to socialize with anyone without dividing the group, and she was quite popular in high school because of her good looks and personality. However, she has never had a steady boyfriend.

She has been in the same class with Yusuke for three years and is the first self-proclaimed fan who appreciates his passion and hidden talent for movies more than anyone else.

She moves into an apartment managed by Yuusuke. She is currently engaged to Reiji Tokito, who was also in the same class.
